manifesto.label: Built on one idea
manifesto.headline: A sale is a sale.
paragraphs: It shouldn't matter whether someone bought online, paid at the counter, renewed a membership or had their access sponsored. To you, the person running the business, it's the same event. The same customer. The same number that needs to add up at the end of the day.
Most software pretends otherwise. It splits your business into five products that don't agree, and then sells you a sixth one to glue them back together.
manifesto.emphasis: Pagayo is built around one Order — for every channel, every payer, every way money comes in.
paragraphsAfter: The webshop, the register, the subscriptions, the memberships, the sponsored access, the donations — they all share the same source of truth. So your numbers match. Your reports tell one story. And the software stays out of your way.
manifesto.close: That's the whole idea. Everything else follows from it.

alwaysShipping.label: Always shipping
alwaysShipping.headline: Pagayo grows every week.
alwaysShipping.intro: New features, new modules, new improvements ship continuously — driven by what the people using Pagayo ask for. Here's what's recently landed in the platform.

items.title: Today
items.body: 2500+ automated deployments. 10 repositories. 59 database tables per tenant. Continuous delivery from the first commit. One developer. Still building.

items.title: AI layer introduced
items.body: AI configuration, action logging, and insight tracking added to the tenant schema. The groundwork for intelligent commerce features — product descriptions, demand forecasting, search.

items.title: Newsletter and announcements
items.body: Built-in newsletter tooling with DNS automation. Social announcements. Tenant-to-customer communication without a third-party dependency.

items.title: Data migration tooling
items.body: Import pipelines for WooCommerce and Magento. Retailers can move their entire catalogue and order history into Pagayo without manual data entry.

productPreview.label: The Platform
productPreview.headline:
One dashboard.
Every order, in real time.
productPreview.intro: Every sale, from every channel, on your own subdomain or custom domain. Your data, your money, your customers — directly connected, with Pagayo quietly keeping the books straight.

channelStrip.headline: Wherever the sale happens — it's the same order.
channelStrip.intro: Webshop, counter, WhatsApp, QR, social, cash. One order model, one ledger, one place to look.

featuresGrid.label: What's Inside
featuresGrid.headline:
Every tool a serious business needs.
Included from day one.
featuresGrid.intro: Orders, products, customers, subscriptions, POS, reporting — all in the free plan. Paid plans add capacity and polish; the feature set stays the same as you grow.

items.title: One Order Model
items.description: Every sale — webshop, POS, WhatsApp, QR, cash — lands in the same order feed. One source of truth, one set of statuses, no channel silos.

items.title: Subscriptions & Memberships
items.description: Recurring billing, family plans, QR check-in, automated renewals. Built for the clubs, gyms and associations that enterprise software priced out.

items.title: Point of Sale
items.description: Turn any device into a register. Card, cash, QR — parked carts, split payments, real-time sync with your online shop. No extra hardware required.

items.title: Honest Reporting
items.description: Revenue, tax, products, payouts — broken down by channel, period and category. Export-ready, accountant-friendly, owned by you.

items.title: Multi-language CMS
items.description: Pages, blog, menus — manage your content in every language your customers speak. SEO-ready, mobile-first, no plugin marketplace.

items.title: Fast Everywhere
items.description: Deployed on a global edge network. Sub-50ms response times in 300+ cities — the same speed in Lagos as in London.

motorsGrid.intro: Pagayo isn't built for one kind of business. It's built for organisations that want to stand on their own — and for the people who help them get there.

cards.title: Fund a Cohort of Entrepreneurs

cards.title: Become a Partner, Earn 50%

partnerCalc.intro: We don't have a sales team — we have partners. Refer an organisation and you earn half of their subscription, every month, for as long as they stay. Funded by us. Never by them.
partnerCalc.footnote: Payout via Stripe. No minimum threshold. Withdraw anytime.

items.title: EU-grade Data Protection
items.description: GDPR compliant. Data hosted in European regions. Your customers' information stays where it belongs — with you.

items.title: 99.99% Uptime
items.description: Running on a global edge network across 300+ cities. Redundant by design — no single point of failure.

items.title: Stripe Payments
items.description: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant. iDEAL, cards, SEPA, Bancontact and more — plus M-Pesa, Flutterwave and Paystack for Africa.

items.title: Your Money, Your Account
items.description: Payouts go directly to your bank via your own Stripe account. We never touch your revenue. No platform float, no held funds.
